findings.text: The 'the armed suite' rows present 58 passed / EXIT=0 at both revisions as one of the fragment's four measured arms, but the command the reviewed manifest records for that pair (manifest.md:18-19) runs only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, and neither file imports reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py (grep -l over tests/ lists no such importer), so that arm cannot fail on a regression of this change and is a promotion-harness selection rather than coverage of it.

The done_when requires the importer arm recorded 'as inline JSON carrying full 40-character revisions'; manifest.md:22 records it as prose. Both 40-character revisions, both counts (8 failed, 294 passed) and the equality of the sorted failure-id sets are present, and node-test-importers-base.log and node-test-importers-head.log on disk corroborate them, but the base arm's log path is named by no manifest field, so a reader has to reconstruct the filename to verify the base half of the clause.

notes: added_failure_count and added_failure_ids were derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs rather than taken from its manifest: baseline_suite-1795075061139730986.log (revision 4584a203aafa020e0709da3db0bb51c7a94ade41) holds no 'FAILED ' line and ends '58 passed' then 'EXIT=0'; after_suite-1795075103990427245.log (revision 2525b92dfabd7ef8d747497b7e640a6a0281569e) likewise ends '58 passed' then 'EXIT=0'. Zero failing ids on each side leaves the added set empty. The importer logs' ids differ only inside the pytest tmp path (pytest-3 versus pytest-44), so their scoped test-id sets are equal. Durability rests on the base arm reddening test_a_decline_only_round_names_its_decision_and_what_it_left on the pre-repair empty-scope wording, which reinstating the old 'filtered to empty' reason at reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:1793 reproduces; the cited-true half of the new branch is measured independently by tests/test_repair_skips_out_of_repo_findings.py:403 test_an_empty_composed_scope_records_a_decline, which asserts 'filtered to empty' for a blocking finding that does cite reckon/crew/recovery.py and would redden if the decline-only reason were used there too. The added assertions at tests/test_a_decline_only_round_names_what_it_declined.py:291-296 compare the recorded reason against literal expected strings and one absence, not against a value the test handed in.
